about: What this repository adds to the generated cell.json (the loader merges it; README, 'The cell is data'). Every value has its reason under 'why'.

why.stands.*.approach_flange_m: A tool leaves its stand along the stand's open side (stand +x, table -x: the fork pieces above stand z 55 mm are on the stand's -x side only) at the stand's pick height (pick_pose_table, 5 mm over the dock). 80 mm out: the tool's neck is 25 mm wide of its axis, the fork reaches 31.4 mm, so 80 mm clears it by 23.6 mm.
why.stands.*.empty_approach_flange_m: The empty changer comes onto a parked tool and leaves it along the tool axis (straight up). 80 mm: the master half (flange z 28.8..65.4 mm) is clear of the tool's changer half (flange z 46.5 mm and up) by then.
why.stands.*.rise_m: The stack beside the rack stands 115 mm high 10 mm from the slide-out path; a straight joint move from the reset pose to a stand swept a tool through it. Joint moves end 150 mm over the approach and the arm goes straight down from there.
why.tools.rcup*.vacuum.spring_*: The cup's give, from the wiki's dvt-01 measurement (tools-and-tool-changes: one cup, vacuum off, about 2 N/mm for its first 2.2 mm, then bottomed out). Which cup was measured is not recorded; both get it.
why.fixtures.button_plate.rgba: The plate is green (its name in cell.json); colour only, no geometry.
